title: Oh No! ...Anyway
blurb: Jeremy Clarkson delivers a masterclass in weaponised indifference: one beat of performed concern, then 'anyway', and the subject is closed forever. The line comes from The Grand Tour and long ago escaped the show, becoming the internet's preferred method of acknowledging a problem while making it perfectly clear you have no intention of engaging with it. Play it over somebody's crypto portfolio, the fifth reschedule of the same meeting, or any consequence that was visible from a considerable distance. Cruel, efficient, and a good deal politer than saying what you actually think.
origin: Jeremy Clarkson's iconic dismissive pivot from The Grand Tour.
